capability_read.finding: Archived artifacts, hashes, exact source validation, and deterministic failure custody are strong. The skill instruction to retain only the first 3 and last 15 turns above 100 turns can silently pre-truncate the authoritative transcript before capture metadata is computed.

The live extractor projects a conversation into one decision situation, one latest synthesized position, and a bounded passage set. V1 showed false stand-downs on material unnamed residual challenges.
Role-first and paired-allocation research improved some semantic boundaries, but those corrected contracts are not the live four-lane runtime.

The raw transcript is retained for ordinary runs, but the live extraction centers the most developed or recent position and does not represent multiple threads and their trajectories as first-class objects.
Provider-free research can produce controlled, fact-stripped reasoning-pattern packets with exact identities, but production integration is not authorized or complete.
The live companion verifier removes recalled candidates before graph expansion and reconsideration, directly violating Constitution v5.
V1 produced no pressure-bearing untouched transfer case, two false stand-downs among seven complete transfer cases, and no real-user usefulness evidence.
Receipt construction and byte-level integrity are strong. A fresh reader has not yet executed the frozen reconstruction contract, and the live caller action overstates what receipt health proves.
The affordable microtask route is promising, but the live boundary lacks output, request-price, cumulative spend, exact cost, and privacy controls needed before further paid or sensitive runs.

drift_findings.title: Probabilistic re-domestication removes deterministic pressure
evidence: four local July 2026 archives: 60 candidates per run; only 2-4 detected, 0-3 rejected, and 53-57 silently omitted
drift_findings.consequence: Only verifier-accepted models receive graph expansion and reach the Step 6 companion surface. Audit telemetry records the omitted candidates but does not restore their opportunity for consideration.
drift_findings.required_action: Replace the verifier-as-deletion-gate with a bounded active-plus-reserve portfolio in which every admitted deterministic pressure candidate remains inspectable and receives apply, reject, or park disposition.

drift_findings.title: The orchestrator may silently pre-truncate long conversations
evidence: docs/skill/STEPS.md::Step 1 rule for conversations above 100 turns
drift_findings.consequence: The mechanical 80,000-character processing cap is visible, but the earlier manual first-3-plus-last-15 instruction can make an incomplete transcript look like a complete captured source if its header describes only retained turns.
drift_findings.required_action: Persist the full available prose transcript as the authoritative artifact. Create a separate declared processing view when compaction is necessary, with source-window references and an unavoidable partial-capture status.

drift_findings.title: Artifact completeness becomes an automatic reliance instruction
evidence: three clean local archives return caller_action=use_revised_answer
drift_findings.consequence: A healthy run envelope is promoted into `use_revised_answer` even though V1 did not establish usefulness, stability, real-user transfer, or receipt reconstruction.
drift_findings.required_action: Use a neutral machine action such as `inspect_revised_answer_and_receipt` or `available_for_review`. Preserve degraded and high-stakes stop behavior without treating clean custody as advice approval.

drift_findings.title: The provider boundary lacks hard cost and output controls
evidence: engine/system_b/boundary_provider.py::_do_call has no max_tokens, provider.max_price, or per-run budget
engine/system_b/boundary_provider.py does not persist OpenRouter usage.cost or response id
engine/system_b/pricing.py price table was last verified 2026-05-25 and overstates current DeepSeek V4 Flash rates
drift_findings.consequence: A model override or verbose completion can spend more than intended, and estimated local prices can diverge from the provider's charged amount.
drift_findings.required_action: Add stage-specific output ceilings, call and USD envelopes, OpenRouter max-price routing, exact response cost and generation-id custody, and a provider-free preflight before any new paid experiment.

drift_findings.title: Provider data-retention policy is implicit
evidence: engine/system_b/boundary_provider.py sends strategic conversation content without an explicit provider.data_collection or provider.zdr preference
OpenRouter provider routing defaults data_collection to allow
drift_findings.consequence: Users cannot tell which retention posture governed a sensitive strategic conversation, and compatible providers may store data unless routing is constrained.
drift_findings.required_action: Define, test, document, and persist an explicit privacy posture. Assess `data_collection=deny` and optional ZDR availability before selecting the safe default.

drift_findings.title: Live extraction collapses multi-thread conversation state
drift_findings.consequence: The most recent or developed position can crowd out parallel options, earlier qualifications, unresolved matters, and reopened conditions that matter to pressure selection and later accountability.
drift_findings.required_action: After structural blockers are fixed, integrate only the smallest proven role-first or paired representation needed for multi-thread source coverage. Do not replace the live architecture wholesale.

drift_findings.title: Same-context reconsideration is documented globally but not disclosed per run
drift_findings.consequence: The current skill asks the original orchestrator to reconsider inside the same trajectory, but a future reader of one run may not see that limitation in the receipt.
drift_findings.required_action: Persist consumer context mode and the self-justification limitation in every run. Test a fresh consumer only after provider-free portfolio contracts pass.

drift_findings.title: Private-table cap and ledger visibility are not proven equivalent
evidence: engine/system_b/pre_step6_private_table.py collects source items before hard-capping rendered markdown
two of four inspected local tables reached the 9,000-character cap
no regression test proves that every ledger-required atom is visible or exactly resolvable
drift_findings.consequence: A ledger can theoretically require a semantic disposition for content the consumer did not fully receive.
drift_findings.required_action: Add a provider-free invariant: every ledger-required item must be fully visible or carry an exact resolvable source pointer available to the consumer.

drift_findings.title: The runtime uses generic JSON mode without enforcing provider capability
evidence: prior complex Gemini schema probes failed while small decomposed schema tasks worked
drift_findings.consequence: The runtime receives weaker structural guarantees than current OpenRouter and Gemini interfaces can provide, while a blanket strict-schema migration could repeat known complexity failures.
drift_findings.required_action: Adopt strict JSON Schema only for small stage-specific contracts that pass local and one-call gates; require parameter support and preserve provider failures without healing.

drift_findings.title: Current product language exceeds the evidence
evidence: README.md described automatic-use fitness and categorical detection
docs/lolla-pitch-and-invitation.md called Lolla a reasoning-quality gate and the output improved reasoning
V1 explicitly says product reliability and usefulness are not established
drift_findings.consequence: Readers can confuse an experimental reasoning-pressure and custody system with a certified reasoning-quality or autonomous-reliance gate.
drift_findings.required_action: Use pressure, reconsideration, custody, and experimental language until blinded usefulness and reconstruction evidence support stronger claims.

drift_findings.title: Codex compatibility lacks an equivalent orchestrator validation claim
evidence: README.md and skill docs support Claude Code and Codex
the documented orchestrator floor and observed regressions are Claude-specific
drift_findings.consequence: Codex users can run the skill, but the repository does not yet establish an equivalent persistence and instruction-following floor for that orchestration surface.
drift_findings.required_action: Describe Codex support as compatible but not equivalently validated, then add provider-free lifecycle conformance fixtures before making a stronger claim.

drift_findings.title: Tool-call custody remains an explicit product boundary question
evidence: docs/skill/STEPS.md intentionally omits tool inputs, outputs, system messages, and file contents
drift_findings.consequence: The prose conversation is preserved, but actions or evidence seen only through tools are outside the authoritative reasoning transcript. Earlier founder discussion treated this as possibly telemetry rather than settled reasoning scope.
drift_findings.required_action: Do not expand scope now. Later decide whether compact tool-event references are necessary for reasoning reconstruction, without dumping tool payloads into the memo or graph path.

adopt: stage-specific strict JSON Schema after local compatibility tests
provider.require_parameters for requests that depend on structured-output support
capability and price refresh before a frozen experiment
small schemas whose shape is carried by the request contract rather than duplicated verbatim in the prompt
reject_for_now: blanket conversion of every broad semantic task to one complex strict schema
automatic response healing or hidden retries
switching the live default to the cheapest model solely on token price
premium-model testing before local constitutional contracts pass

decisions.current_live_default: keep google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite provisionally; it passed the exact small-task probe that cheaper DeepSeek did not
decisions.premium_models: do not use Gemini 3.5 Flash for routine testing; retain its outputs only as benchmark evidence
decisions.next_paid_call: not authorized until provider-free stages R1 and R2 pass
